Overview

Savannah is a city in GA with a population of 147,780. Hostess City with Spanish moss, historic squares, and coastal Southern beauty. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.7.
